//: Capability manifest for <FormGroup> (the .pa-form-group container) — svelte-pure-admin. FormGroup.svelte is a <div class="pa-form-group {state} {required} {horizontal} {class}"> with a `children` snippet. state→--{state}, isRequired→--required, isHorizontal→--horizontal, plus class passthrough + slot. keen's label/field have no svelte counterpart (container content, prose-deferred).
